basic_profile.bio: Avid mobile gamer who recently got into Fate/Grand Order. Based in the Midwest, USA, I juggle my time between work at a local bike shop and my passion for gaming. Despite being new to Reddit, I'm eager to learn and connect with others over shared interests. I'm single and usually online during late evenings after work. I have a particular interest in cycling and tend to visit related subreddits often.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise in gaming comes from years of playing various mobile games and engaging with related online communities. Although new to FGO, I've been learning quickly through trial and error and by reading guides from seasoned players.
